name: What should I consider before selecting and placing grab bars?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before selecting and placing grab bars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling, observe where you or your family member naturally reaches for balance when entering, washing, and stepping out of the shower. Measure the height of the current shower curb or tub edge, and check if your shower walls are fiberglass, ceramic tile, or natural stone. It is also helpful to decide whether you want textured, slip-resistant bars or standard smooth finishes, and whether you prefer modern decorative styles that blend into your bathroom hardware rather than looking institutional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify where you naturally reach for balance, measure user height preferences, check your wall material, and choose between smooth or textured grip finishes.
